title: Abimelech's Conspiracy

questions.question: Who went to Shechem to his mother's relatives to become king?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:1 (ESV): "Now Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother's relatives..."

questions.question: How many of his brothers did Abimelech kill?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:5 (ESV): "...and killed his brothers... seventy men, on one stone. But Jotham... escaped..."

questions.question: Who escaped the massacre?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:5 (ESV): "...But Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal escaped, for he hid himself."

questions.question: From where did Jotham speak his parable?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:7 (ESV): "...Jotham... went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and cried aloud..."

questions.question: How did Abimelech die?
options: A woman dropped a millstone on his head
questions.correctAnswer: A woman dropped a millstone on his head
questions.explanation: Judges 9:53 (ESV): "And a certain woman threw an upper millstone on Abimelech's head and crushed his skull."

questions.question: In Jotham's parable, which tree was finally asked to be king?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:14 (ESV): "Then all the trees said to the bramble, 'Come you, and reign over us.'"

questions.question: Who stirred up the Shechemites against Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:26 (ESV): "And Gaal the son of Ebed moved into Shechem with his relatives, and the leaders of Shechem put confidence in him."

questions.question: Who was the ruler of the city (Shechem) loyal to Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:30 (ESV): "When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal..."

questions.question: What did Abimelech allow his armor-bearer to do?
options: Kill him so they wouldn't say a woman killed him
questions.correctAnswer: Kill him so they wouldn't say a woman killed him
questions.explanation: Judges 9:54 (ESV): "...Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say of me, 'A woman killed him.' And his young man thrust him through, and he died."

questions.question: What did Abimelech do to the city of Shechem after capturing it?
options: Razed it and sowed it with salt
questions.correctAnswer: Razed it and sowed it with salt
questions.explanation: Judges 9:45 (ESV): "...And he razed the city and sowed it with salt."

questions.question: How long did Abimelech rule over Israel?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:22 (ESV): "Abimelech ruled over Israel three years."

questions.question: Who sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:23 (ESV): "And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem..."

questions.question: What happened to the people in the Tower of Shechem?
options: Abimelech burned the stronghold over them, killing about 1000 men and women
questions.correctAnswer: Abimelech burned the stronghold over them, killing about 1000 men and women
questions.explanation: Judges 9:49 (ESV): "...So Abimelech... set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the Tower of Shechem also died, about 1,000 men and women."

questions.question: Where did the people of the Tower of Shechem take refuge?
options: In the stronghold of the house of El-berith
questions.correctAnswer: In the stronghold of the house of El-berith
questions.explanation: Judges 9:46 (ESV): "...they entered the stronghold of the house of El-berith."

questions.question: The events of this chapter fulfilled whose curse?
questions.explanation: Judges 9:57 (ESV): "...and on them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal."

key_verse_text: Thus God returned the evil of Abimelech, which he committed against his father in killing his seventy brothers. (ESV)
